title: Reasonableness after adding a constant
statement: Let $\Omega$ be finite, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ have mean zero and third moment zero under $p$, and suppose $X$ is reasonable with constant $3$. Then for every $c\in\mathbb{R}$, the function $x\mapsto c+X(x)$ is reasonable with constant $3$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
The mean of $X$ under $p$ is zero
The third moment of $X$ under $p$ is zero
